title: Legal Effect and Legal Interrogation authoritative glossary

records.definition: Original retained document/source material plus identity/provenance; ingestion does not itself certify legal authority.
Structured candidate meaning derived from source text, with modality, actor/subject, act/object, conditions, exceptions and provenance.
Upstream authoring/cross-examination layer that asks clause-level questions, reviews answers and challenges propositions before Legal Effect compilation.
Detached revision-bound non-authoritative authoring snapshot offered to a host Legal Effect adapter after required clause/document closure.
Compiler-certified structured legal-semantic/evaluation domain; not an LLM opinion and not Institutional Policy publication authority.
Proposal object entering the Legal Effect compilation path with required source/provision/evidence references; proposal status is not compiler authority.
Sealed/certified generation used by the Legal Effect engine after the compiler authority boundary.
Explicit unresolved/contested outcome requiring legal review or more evidence; never a licence for a model to guess.
Failure state when the legal authoring revision changed after a compile handoff was issued.
Failure state when a previously advertised Intention surface no longer matches the legal session revision/state.
Historical proposition retained for audit but retired from the active legal interpretation and compile snapshot.
Intention Service freshness generation that changes when specialist discovery signature changes; it is not a legal authority generation.
Explicit hypothetical legal-effect comparison labelled non-authoritative unless separately established through real evidence/compilation.
Shared fixed/versioned publication and deployment governance substrate; domain legal semantics remain with Legal Effect.

records.term: Legal Interrogation Legal Effect v0.14 bridge
records.definition: Concrete dev6 adapter that projects a closed interrogation handoff into verified Legal Effect compilation inputs without acquiring compiler authority.
LegalSourceIdentity whose verification state is backed by verifier-issued LegalSourceVerificationEvidence matching the exact source digest; an asserted status alone is insufficient.
Frozen source/provision/proposal input boundary validated by LegalRuleCompiler; constructing one does not itself create an authority-bearing generation.
A sealed LegalRuleGeneration carrying a LegalRuleCompiler-issued compilation certificate.

provenance.claim: Legal Effect v0.14 owns structured legal-effect evaluation and the compiler/certification authority boundary; public legal API remains legal.effect/0.10.
Intention Service dev11 owns CLARIFY/CONFIRM/READY resolution, discovery-provider refresh/replacement semantics and discovery-generation stamping.
Institutional Policy owns fixed/versioned publication identity, authority, effective time, lifecycle, topology, rollout and replay rather than domain legal semantics.
Legal Interrogation dev5 implements clause interrogation, proposition challenge, lifecycle invalidation and a real Intention Service dev11 discovery adapter.
